Welcome back to the channel.
Today we are going to talk about money habits.
Why do most people never save a single rupee of their raise?
The answer is lifestyle creep, and it happens to almost everyone.
When your income goes up by twenty percent, your spending quietly follows it.
A new phone here, a bigger apartment there.
Within two years the raise is gone and the savings rate is exactly where it started.
That is why the fix has to be automatic.
Set up a transfer for half of every raise on the day it lands.
You never see the money, so you never miss it.
In other words, you save before you can spend.
This is something I mentioned earlier.
It also connects to what we discussed about rent.
And then there was the other thing.
Anyway, let me get some water.
Here is the surprising part about compound growth.
If you invest five thousand rupees a month at ten percent, you have about one crore in twenty years.
Wait ten years longer and that number roughly triples.
Time in the market does more work than picking the perfect fund.
So the lesson is simple: start early, even with small amounts.
